info.description: Track how AI assistants (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Perplexity) mention your brand versus competitors: share of voice, position, sentiment and cited sources.
info.title: AI Visibility Tracker

post.description: Create a user and their first workspace.

get.description:
Share of voice, mention rate, average position and sentiment for every tracked
brand: KPIs (with deltas vs the previous period), a daily series, and a per-model
breakdown. Defaults to the last 30 days.
Leaderboard of the domains AI answers cite most.

Prompts with 7-day visibility of the primary brand (two grouped queries per
page, never one per prompt).

post.description:
Bulk import from CSV. Uses a ``prompt`` column if present (else the first
column) and an optional ``tags`` column separated by ``;``. Duplicates of
existing prompts are skipped, not errors.

get.description:
Every answer to this prompt, newest first, with mentions/sources from the
current analysis version. Keyset-paginated on (day, id).

post.description:
Re-run the analysis stage (current ``ANALYSIS_VERSION``) over stored raw
responses in a date range and rebuild the rollups. No provider calls.

schema.title: Response Reanalyze Api V1 Workspaces  Workspace Id  Reanalyze Post

post.description:
Start a manual run over all active prompts x the workspace's models (or the
subset given). Returns immediately; poll ``GET /runs/{id}`` for progress.

get.description: Run status with live progress and running cost per model.

post.description: Re-queue every dead-lettered task of the run with a fresh retry budget.

get.description: Tasks of a run (keyset on id). ``status=dead`` is the dead-letter view.
Readiness: Postgres and Redis are reachable.
